statBlock.name: Ankheg
statBlock.description: A burrowing insectoid predator bursts out of its tunnel to seize prey in its mandibles or spray acid at creatures nearby.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a tunnel 10 ft. in diameter.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. The ankheg has Advantage if it already has the target Grappled. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 13.
Acid Spray (recharge 6). Each creature in a line 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. It takes 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

statBlock.name: Basilisk
statBlock.description: This many-legged reptile can turn creatures to stone with its gaze. A reflection can subject the basilisk to its own magic.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Petrifying Gaze (recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. The basilisk also saves if it sees its own reflection in the cone. An initial failure makes the creature Restrained. If the creature is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. On a second failure, Petrified replaces Restrained.

statBlock.name: Cockatrice
statBlock.description: A cockatrice is a small, winged creature with a rooster-like head. Its bite can leave a creature petrified for a day.

sections.Actions: Petrifying Bite. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. A creature hit by the bite also makes a DC 11 Constitution save. Failure makes it Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. On a second failure, it becomes Petrified for 24 hours and is no longer Restrained.

statBlock.name: Chimera
statBlock.description: A chimera combines a lion, a goat, and a dragon in one body. Its three heads can attack together while its wings carry it above the battlefield.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Ram, one Bite, and one Claw attack. The chimera can use Fire Breath in place of Claw if the breath is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack.
Claw. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Ram. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the attack also falls Prone.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

statBlock.name: Gorgon
statBlock.description: A gorgon resembles a metal-plated bull. Its charge can knock foes down, and its breath can turn them to stone.

sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the attack falls Prone if the gorgon moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit.
Petrifying Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. An initial failure makes the creature Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. On a second failure, Petrified replaces Restrained.
sections.Bonus actions: Trample. Choose one Prone creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 16 Dexterity save and takes 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

statBlock.name: Hydra
statBlock.description: A hydra fights with all of its heads at once. Cutting down a head gives it a chance to grow two, and fire can interrupt that regrowth.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Multiple Heads. The hydra starts with five heads. Each time it takes at least 25 damage on a single turn, one head dies. The hydra dies when it loses its last head. At the end of each of its turns, if it has a living head and has taken no fire damage since its last turn, it grows two heads for each head that died since its last turn. Growing new heads restores 20 HP.
Reactive Heads. Each head after the first grants one additional Reaction that the hydra can use only to make an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack per living head.
Bite. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Wyvern
statBlock.description: A wyvern hunts from the air and strikes with its jaws and venomous tail.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Sting attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Sting. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of the wyvern's next turn.
